title: Organization
description: A company a signal is about. A part that composite types compose at org (competitor-funding, product-launch); a listener for organization@^1 hears the org part of every one of them. It starts a person's master record, competitors/<id>.json, once, when the record is missing.
subject: The organization's slug

cases.note: first takes the earliest standing value in (time, id) order, so the first name wins. The record is created once: a later render that finds it, written by a person or by this projection, leaves it alone.
Each field folds on its own: a signal without a domain contributes nothing to domain, so the domain comes from the first report that has one.

note: Open type in the competitors package (the implicit library naive).
